ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Anand Rathi Financial Services Limited, promoter of Anand Rathi Wealth Limited, has re-pledged 5.14 lakh shares (0.31% of total share capital) with Yes Bank Limited to facilitate margin limits, simultaneously releasing a similar number of shares from a previous pledge. This transaction represents a collateral shift to another broker rather than a net increase in overall encumbrance, with total promoter encumbered shares remaining at 29.31% of their holding. No significant red flags are identified, given the administrative nature of the transaction and an adequate security cover of 1.12x.
